## Enterprise demand digest
Reads n8n's public Feature Requests forum, asks **Jev** (TypeSafe System One) three typed questions per request: product area (choice), enterprise impact (score 0 to 3) and whether it looks one-off (yes/no probability). Code ranks areas by *distinct demand × impact*, so many voices beat one loud request, and separates what is probably not roadmap.

**Setup:** create a Header Auth credential (`Authorization` = `Bearer <TypeSafe API key>`) on *Classify with Jev*. Connect Google Sheets on *Update backlog sheet* (set your spreadsheet) and GitHub on the two report nodes (set your repo).

Independent project · not affiliated with n8n

Where is enterprise demand going in n8n?

A live workflow that reads n8n's public feature requests, asks Jev to judge each one, and shows which enterprise needs keep coming up and which requests should stay off the roadmap.

  • ~90feature requests per run
  • 3Jev judgments each
  • ~30 send to end
  1. Collect. The most voted and most recently active requests from community.n8n.io.
  2. Judge. Jev (TypeSafe) returns a product area, an enterprise impact score and a one-off probability for each request.
  3. Rank. Code weighs distinct demand by enterprise impact, updates a backlog sheet and shows you the report.

Built by Gonzalo Geronés

Three-time founder and product leader based in Valencia. I built a white-label platform that 15 telcos launched for their own customers, worked on pricing and paywalls at Lingokids, and build products hands-on with Python, SQL and AI agents. I made this to understand n8n's enterprise users better.
